note: Values are the independent expectations for a future linux/amd64 run. This session has no observed SQL Server result.

amt_precision.basis: decimal(38,10) inserted from a decimal string, not a float literal

survives_float_roundtrip.basis: 9007199254740993.0000000001 is outside exact float64. decimal to float to decimal must change it

null_notes.basis: rows 1, 5, and 6 store NULL. Empty string is a separate row

empty_notes.basis: SQL Server keeps N'' distinct from NULL

bin_case_equal.basis: Latin1_General_BIN2 compares code points. U+0041 is not U+0061

bin_trail_equal.basis: character equality still applies ANSI trailing-space padding under BIN2. Byte identity is the next flag

bin_trail_bytes_equal.basis: CONVERT(varbinary) keeps the extra UTF-16 space

bin_key_order.basis: binary(4) unsigned byte order of the six keys as loaded

name_bin_order.basis: NULL sorts lowest, then BIN2 code points U+0041, U+005A, U+0061, U+4E2D, U+6587

reader_sysadmin.basis: reader login is not a server admin

is_cdc_enabled.basis: fixture does not call sp_cdc_enable_db. DBP2 is still required before any CDC claim

change_tracking_on.basis: fixture does not enable change tracking

negative_writes.rule: Any non-zero error is a denial. Error 0 is a least-privilege failure. A different non-zero number is recorded and is still a denial.

cancel.mechanism: Kill the reader client during WAITFOR so the TDS connection drops. Do not grant KILL to the reader.
cancel.expected: DBA sees the reader request gone and an attention event for oo_dl01w1_09_reader.

zero_write_audit.rule: Successful INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, CREATE, ALTER, DROP, or TRUNCATE from the reader fails the observation. A denied write is the negative journey.
